dossier.name: Polycab India Limited

lines.text: Polycab India Limited recorded a market capitalization of ₹1,19,134 Cr with FY26 revenue of ₹28,884 Cr and PAT of ₹2,708 Cr.
The company's operating margin stood at 14.0% while ROCE reached 33.0% in FY26.
Its segment revenue includes EPC at ₹617 Cr.

claim.text: Asked in 8 of 8 calls. Latest: “What are the key drivers for FMEG margin reaching 10.1% and are targets going to be revised?”

citations.title: Q2 FY27 call transcript
citations.quote: So if you see the 10.1% is already at the upper end of your projected targets. So could you highlight what are the key drivers behind it, and which of these segments are profitable? Is this solely contributed by the solar segment, and would you be looking to revise your Project Spring targets?

citations.title: Q1 FY27 call transcript
citations.quote: Given how steep a price increase have we seen in the fibre side, how do you see the profitability of these projects panning out over the next couple of years? And also, we have seen that overall, the EPC revenue has been quite weak. Any particular reason that's impacted this revenue?

citations.title: Q4 FY26 call transcript
citations.quote: The question is on the EBIT segment margin for the cables or overall EBITDA margin. Basically, it is within the guided range, but in the backdrop of, say, lower export mix or primary, secondary sales and stocking, where do you see it settling, say, in next 2, 3 quarters? How should we think of it?

claim.text: Asked in 8 of 8 calls. Latest: “What are the downside risks to Project Spring targets from new suppliers entering the market?”

citations.title: Q2 FY27 call transcript
citations.quote: And secondly, in terms of the new suppliers that are coming into the market. So do you what is the downside risk that you see to your Project Spring targets in terms of the growth as well as margins?

citations.title: Q1 FY27 call transcript
citations.quote: Now we understand that 13% decline, was it largely because of Middle East? And how do we foresee the coming quarters?

citations.title: Q4 FY26 call transcript
citations.quote: Congratulations on a great set of numbers despite the Middle East disruption. Sir, my first question is of the Cables & Wires sales growth of 30%, if we could break up on the approximate growth -- volume growth in Cables & Wires and also the price hikes that we have taken from Jan till now in different tranches?

claim.text: Asked in 7 of 8 calls. Latest: “What is the specific volume and value growth breakdown for cables and wires?”

citations.title: Q2 FY27 call transcript
citations.quote: My first question is in cables and wires domestic, you have grown 50%, overall you have grown 47% revenues. What could be our volume growth? And what could be our value growth for that?

citations.title: Q1 FY27 call transcript
citations.quote: If you can indicate the price hikes and volume growth in this quarter on a year-on-year basis. And now considering the copper prices, how do you see the pricing working out for Q2? That is question number one.

citations.title: Q4 FY26 call transcript
citations.quote: First, if you can quantify what sort of impact you had in March on account of these Middle East-related disruptions?

claim.text: Asked in 6 of 8 calls. Latest: “What is the unorganized market share in the house wire segment?”

citations.title: Q2 FY27 call transcript
citations.quote: My question regarding, you mentioned that what is the unorganized competition in unorganized market in the wire segment currently, household segment?

citations.title: Q1 FY27 call transcript
citations.quote: So does this imply market share gain for Polycab in wires segment? And how much will be the market share, if you can quantify?

citations.title: Q3 FY26 call transcript
citations.quote: Congrats on the strong set of numbers. So, you highlighted 40% domestic volume growth. In your sense, what would have been industry growth and where is your market share trending now? Any qualitative colour will also be helpful.

claim.text: Asked in 4 of 8 calls. Latest: “When can EHV plant be commissioned and contribute to top line?”

citations.title: Q2 FY27 call transcript
citations.quote: Just wanted to check on the EHV side of the business. When can we expect it to be commissioned and when can we expect it to start contributing to the top line?

citations.title: Q4 FY26 call transcript
citations.quote: Firstly, in terms of capacity utilization, I think you mentioned we were around 70-odd percent. Do we have any capacity coming in anytime soon in FY27? And is there a possibility that we may run out of capacity if that's not the case?

citations.title: Q2 FY26 call transcript
citations.quote: So, one of your peers had mentioned on their con call that their EHV plant is facing issues in terms of non-availability of technicians for vertical lines. Now I understand Polycab is also setting up vertical lines for EHV. So, are you facing any such issues in terms of non-availability of technicians and therefore, any delay? Or are we on track for it to commission?

bull.text: Revenue grew at a 5-year CAGR of 26.9% while PAT achieved a 5-year CAGR of 25.0%.
The business generated free cash flow of ₹2,340 Cr in FY26 with a low Debt/Equity ratio of 0.02x.

bear.text: Management revised its lower-end expectation for EPC annual operating margins from high single digits to mid-to-high single digits.

citations.title: Q3 FY26 call transcript
citations.quote: Segment profitability stood at ₹ 272 million, translating to a margin of 6.7%. Looking ahead, the annual sustainable operating margin is expected to remain in the high single digits over mid- to long term.

citations.title: Q4 FY26 call transcript
citations.quote: Looking ahead, the annual sustainable operating margin is expected to remain in the mid- to high single digits over mid- to long term.

bear.text: Management identified risks regarding geopolitical tensions, elevated energy prices, global bond yields, and shipping route disruptions.

citations.title: Q2 FY27 call transcript
citations.quote: Geopolitical tensions, elevated energy prices, higher global bond yields, and disruptions across certain international shipping routes have created near-term uncertainty across markets.

bear.text: The company faces operational risks from commodity volatility, geopolitical developments, and logistics-related disruptions.

citations.title: Q2 FY27 call transcript
citations.quote: While commodity volatility, geopolitical developments, and logistics-related disruptions may continue to influence individual quarters, the structural drivers of the demand remain firmly intact and in place.
